strategy: SPY 45-DTE put credit spread, short leg selected by delta (~0.20), $5 fixed width

Not a candidate for promotion; this registration is for the delta-selected variant only.

evidence_at_promotion_2026_08_12.shortfall: Promoted at 3/20 observations, 1/3 expirations — reports/bull_put_delta_selected_shadow_launch.json's own pre-registered bar was NOT met before this promotion. Deliberate, human-confirmed exception (2026-08-12 session): live paper trading is treated as how the remaining evidence gets collected, consistent with this project's explicit priority that paper-trading learnings matter more than exact backtest results. This is an honest disclosure of a promotion-before-bar decision, not a claim the bar was met.

sizing_rationale: allocation_pct (6%) is sized to admit exactly one contract at the structure's live-quoted ~$490/contract maximum_loss (4.8% of ~$10,266 2x-lab equity) with margin, not the smaller 1-2% default first considered — that default cannot afford even one contract, which would leave the experiment registered but structurally unable to ever trade. max_cumulative_loss_pct is set equal to allocation_pct: the maximum any single bad structure (capped at one open structure at a time by engine/options_risk.py) can cost is exactly the full allocation.

options_level_verified.checked_via: scripts/check_options_level.py, and inline every run in scripts/options_daily.py
options_level_verified.note: Alpaca requires options trading Level 3 for multi-leg spreads. This has not been verified against the real account from within this development session (no live credentials here) — scripts/check_options_level.py must be run by hand against the real 2x paper account, and scripts/options_daily.py refuses loudly (CRITICAL, no orders) if the level check fails on any given run, whether or not it was checked in advance.

promotion_policy: Quote freshness: engine/options_risk.py rejects any structure with a leg quote older than 120 seconds.

Positive displayed size on every leg: inherited from scripts/options_shadow.py's select_delta_quote_pair, which already filters for positive bid/ask price and size on every candidate leg before this structure is ever proposed.

Atomic multi-leg order construction: Alpaca's order_class=mleg semantics submit and fill the whole structure as one broker-side order, not as separate per-leg orders — engine/execute.py's Trader.submit_multi_leg_order issues exactly one POST /v2/orders call per structure (open or close).
Exit handling: close_by_dte_trading_days=5 forces a close well before expiration; a stand-down also forces an immediate close (close_reason=standdown_flatten).

Assignment handling: detection, not automatic remediation, for v1 — engine/../scripts/options_daily.py's reconcile_option_structures checks every open structure's legs still match broker positions and that no unexplained equity position exists in the underlying, on every run and a second time daily via scripts/healthcheck.py --profile 2x. Any anomaly is a loud CRITICAL with no automatic trading response, because this repo has never observed whether Alpaca's paper broker simulates early assignment at all or only settles at expiration.

Account-level loss limits: max_cumulative_loss_pct=0.06 via the same compute_experiment_standdowns machinery engine/risk.py already uses for equity experiments — a breach stands the experiment down and forces an immediate close of any open structure.
limitations: Carried forward from reports/bull_put_delta_selected_shadow_launch.json: the free indicative options feed modifies quotes and may not represent an executable OPRA market; American early assignment and expiration handling are not backtested; delta-based selection can land on a materially different strike week to week as implied vol moves.

Realized P&L for the stand-down check is tracked only at structure close (no intra-trade mark-to-market) — acceptable for v1 because a single open structure's worst case is already bounded by its own gate-approved maximum_loss at entry; this only affects how quickly a string of realized losses across multiple round trips is detected, not the bound on any one structure.

The credit/debit sign-convention negation in Trader.submit_multi_leg_order, and the payload shape itself, have not been confirmed against a real Alpaca fill from within this development session — the first live order is the actual confirmation.
Whether Alpaca's paper broker simulates early assignment at all is unverified; the assignment-detection backstop's real-world reliability is unproven until observed.
